issue_request: Published/Persuasive OO correction for the Observation f202 example, asking to fix bodySite "Entire body as a whole" because an oral temperature does not measure the entire body as a body site.
initial_application: Historical commit 474be19befc8b8882da2b23a826dd0e2106a1538 changed source/observation/observation-example-f202-temperature.xml from SNOMED CT 38266002 "Entire body as a whole" to 74262004 "Oral cavity". The commit subject did not mention FHIR-7232, but the patch exactly matches the requested bodySite correction.
additional_context: Observation is active in source/fhir.ini, and source/observation/list-Observation-examples.xml lists Observation/f202 as the real-world temperature example, so the inspected XML is current build-scoped source. Related trackers FHIR-7212 and FHIR-7213 concern the same May 2015 oral-temperature example; they were treated as context rather than additional decided issues.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit on the combined branch. No source edit was needed because the current f202 bodySite already uses Oral cavity and no longer contains the bad "Entire body as a whole" bodySite at this location.
